purpose: Hidden forehead/temple underpainting only. Original art supplies visible hair and body.

assets.name: sonya
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied full-body Sonya anime sprite. Create a reconstruction underpainting plate for animation. Preserve canvas composition, exact pose, proportions, eyes, mouth, skin color, clothes, hands and all pixels away from hair. Remove ONLY the hanging front fringe/bangs over the forehead and temples and the narrow curl in front of the visible right ear, revealing and completing the previously hidden forehead, eyebrows, temple and ear. Keep the crown, upper hair silhouette, ponytail, bow and back hair unchanged. Front hair should now stop at the forehead hairline, leaving a broad uninterrupted skin forehead above the eyes. This is a hidden underpainting; no new styling, no altered expression, no moving or resizing features. Retain the original cel shading and sharp black linework. Output the complete sprite at the same aspect ratio, transparent background, no checkerboard, no labels.
